Medium
Handover reason:Main breaker issue.
Handover reason: The charger is currently showing Error Code 1, which is related to the ECOG.
Following the report of the client, we see that the following error flags are showing, related to errorcode 1.
Please check the following steps:
Check the Ethernet cable
Then  switch
Check the ecoG KF11
If both the cable and switch port are working properly, consider replacing
the ecoG KF11
.

eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue

additional_info.subject: AW: ID0480114-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / S4 170003501] Main breaker issue CRM:03275000111
additional_info.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for handing over our service request to the Support of RC-DE SI E.
Some more information regarding the error. In my opinion it is not an error of an ethernet cable, the switch or the EcoG charge controller.
The error is caused by the motor operator of the main breaker, which doesn’t work in a proper way. The main breaker cannot be armed for the next switch on operation.
We kindly ask you for your support to fix the error and to get in contact with us to clarify the next steps.
Thanks in advance.
With best regards,
